description.en-US: Lyric file parsers for LRC, SRT and WebVTT. The app's lyric pane is powered entirely by this plugin — there is no built-in parser.
description.zh-CN: LRC、SRT、WebVTT 歌词文件解析器。应用的歌词显示完全由本插件驱动，应用内没有内置解析器。

description.en-US: OneDrive cloud storage provider (directory listing + byte-range download) implemented as a headless rut plugin.
description.zh-CN: OneDrive 云存储插件（目录列表 + 区间下载）。

description.en-US: Counts how many times each music has been played, filterable by time period (Today through Last Year) and by playlist membership.
description.zh-CN: 统计每首歌的播放次数，支持按时间段（今天到最近一年）和按播放列表成员过滤。

description.en-US: Amazon S3 / S3-compatible object storage provider (ListObjectsV2 directory listing + SigV4 signed byte-range download; works with AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, B2, ...) implemented as a headless rut plugin.
description.zh-CN: S3 / 兼容 S3 的对象存储插件（ListObjectsV2 目录列表 + SigV4 签名区间下载；支持 AWS S3、Cloudflare R2、MinIO、B2 等）。

description.en-US: WebDAV cloud storage provider (directory listing + byte-range download, Basic/Digest auth) implemented as a headless rut plugin.
description.zh-CN: WebDAV 云存储插件（目录列表 + 区间下载，支持 Basic/Digest 认证）。
